answer: Reputation Decay Ledger: each identity accrues a public score that rises only when its actions survive periodic audits; clones start at zero and must pay audit escrow per registration plus accumulated withholding until they reach the summit of usable trust. Scores unlock a shared vault of fee rebates, so honest agents recover escrow while farmers lose it. Any whisper of collusion between linked identities forfeits the whole cluster's escrow, making each clone a net drain rather than a cheap duplicate.
